notes.title: Announcement of suspension of updates
notes.content: I regret to inform you that due to insufficient time and funds, and insufficient technical accumulation, the game has been decided to be put on hold for a period of time after evaluating various factors. During this period, I will participate in the development of other more suitable game projects, some of which will be available on Steam, so stay tuned.

notes.title: v0.1.2 implements network functions
notes.content:
The network function has been implemented. Players can create rooms in the lobby and join the rooms. They can also create private rooms and invite friends to join.
There is no Gameplay yet, and the Gameplay demo is under development.

notes.title: Game testing is open for a long time
notes.content:
The game test is open for a long time, and the application for test qualification will be passed within one week.
This game was developed independently by an individual developer. If you have any questions, please contact me.
By AIM
